repos.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
repos.summary_zh: 腾讯开源的WeKnora是LLM驱动的文档智能框架，基于RAG范式实现深度文档理解与语义检索。采用模块化架构，支持多模态预处理、父-子分块、智能检索与重排序，可处理复杂异构文档。集成Milvus向量数据库，提供上下文感知的高质量问答，适用于企业知识库、智能客服等场景。
repos.summary_en: WeKnora, Tencent's open-source LLM-powered framework, enables deep document understanding and semantic retrieval via RAG paradigm. Its modular architecture supports multimodal preprocessing, hierarchical parent-child chunking, intelligent retrieval, and reranking for complex heterogeneous documents. Integrated with Milvus vector database, it delivers context-aware answers for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent customer service.

repos.description: A powerful tool for creating datasets for LLM fine-tuning 、RAG and Eval
repos.summary_zh: Easy Dataset 是一款专为大语言模型训练设计的数据集构建工具。它支持 PDF、Markdown、DOCX 等格式的智能解析与切分，可自动生成高质量问答对、多轮对话及图像问答数据集。内置领域标签树、数据清洗和增强功能，适用于微调、RAG 和评估场景。1.7.0 版本新增评估系统。
repos.summary_en: Easy Dataset is a specialized tool for building LLM training datasets. It intelligently parses and chunks documents in PDF, Markdown, DOCX, TXT, and EPUB formats, automatically generating high-quality QA pairs, multi-turn dialogues, and visual QA datasets. Features include domain label trees, data cleaning/augmentation, and support for fine-tuning, RAG, and evaluation scenarios. Version 1.7.0 introduces a comprehensive evaluation system with multi-dimensional assessment and human blind testing capabilities for domain-specific model validation, post-fine-tuning evaluation, and RAG recall rate assessment tasks in production environments.

repos.summary_zh: garak是NVIDIA开源的LLM漏洞扫描与红队评估工具，专注检测幻觉、数据泄露、提示注入、越狱、毒性生成等风险。支持Hugging Face、OpenAI、Bedrock等多种后端，结合静态、动态与自适应探针，类似nmap/Metasploit但专为生成式AI设计，助力模型安全加固。
repos.summary_en: garak is NVIDIA’s open-source LLM vulnerability scanner and red-teaming kit. It probes for hallucination, data leakage, prompt injection, jailbreaks, toxicity and more. Supporting Hugging Face, OpenAI, Bedrock and many backends, it combines static, dynamic and adaptive probes—like nmap/Metasploit for generative AI—to harden model safety.

repos.summary_zh: Manifest 是开源 LLM 网关，专为 AI Agent 与应用设计。通过统一 OpenAI 兼容端点，智能路由 API Key、订阅与本地模型请求至最优模型，支持 300+ 模型与 35+ 提供商。核心能力包括自动降级与故障自愈、全量请求日志、实时成本追踪与限额告警，消除单一供应商锁定，显著提升 Agent 可靠性并降低调用成本。
repos.summary_en: Manifest is an open-source LLM gateway for AI agents and apps. It unifies API keys, subscriptions, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, intelligently routing requests to the optimal model across 300+ models and 35+ providers. Key features include automatic fallbacks with self-healing, full request logging, real-time cost tracking, and usage limits—eliminating vendor lock-in while boosting agent reliability and cutting costs.

repos.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs
repos.summary_zh: 融合怪(VPS Fusion Monster)是功能全面的服务器测评脚本，提供自动化硬件与网络基准测试。Go重构版本彻底解耦环境依赖，支持非root用户运行，兼容多架构(amd64/arm64等)与主流Linux发行版。核心功能涵盖CPU/内存/磁盘性能测试、三网回程路由追踪、多节点网速测试及15数据库IP质量检测。支持交互菜单与参数化无值守模式，可自定义Geekbench版本、磁盘测试工具等，专为开发者与运维人员设计的极致轻量高效测评方案。
repos.summary_en: Fusion Monster (ECS) is a comprehensive server testing script for VPS benchmarking. The Go-based implementation eliminates environment dependencies, supports non-root execution, and maintains compatibility across multiple architectures (amd64/arm64/i386/arm) and Linux distributions. Core capabilities include CPU/memory/disk performance evaluation, triple-network routing analysis, multi-node speed tests, and IP quality validation via 15 databases. Features both interactive menu and headless parameter-driven modes, with customizable options for Geekbench versions, disk test utilities, and China-specific network endpoints, designed for developers and sysadmins.

repos.description: Find the local LLM that actually runs and performs best on your hardware. Ranked by real, recency-aware benchmarks, not parameter count. One command, run it instantly.
repos.summary_zh: whichllm 是一款命令行工具，自动检测 GPU/CPU/RAM，从 Hugging Face 筛选适配模型，基于 LiveBench、Chatbot Arena 等真实多源基准进行 recency-aware 排名，而非参数量或 VRAM 简单匹配。支持 GPU 模拟、升级对比、模型规划、聊天启动及 JSON 输出，一条 uvx 命令即可运行。核心价值是证据驱动的本地 LLM 推荐，帮助用户在硬件限制下选出性能最优模型。
repos.summary_en: whichllm is a CLI tool that auto-detects hardware (GPU/CPU/RAM) and ranks the best-fitting local LLMs from Hugging Face using aggregated real-world benchmarks like LiveBench and Chatbot Arena, with recency awareness rather than size or VRAM heuristics. It supports GPU simulation, upgrade comparisons, model planning, chat launching, and JSON output. Run instantly via one uvx command. Delivers evidence-graded recommendations for optimal performance on specific hardware.

repos.description: An AI-Powered Speech Processing Toolkit and Open Source SOTA Pretrained Models, Supporting Speech Enhancement, Separation, and Target Speaker Extraction, etc.
repos.summary_zh: ClearerVoice-Studio是阿里巴巴开源的AI语音处理工具包，集成语音增强、分离、超分辨率及目标说话人提取等SOTA预训练模型。支持10+音频格式与立体声处理，提供灵活的NumPy接口和完整训练/推理脚本。其FRCRN降噪模型已在ModelScope被调用超300万次，为研究、开发和生产提供一站式解决方案。
repos.summary_en: ClearerVoice-Studio is an open-source AI-powered speech processing toolkit by Alibaba, featuring SOTA pretrained models for speech enhancement, separation, super-resolution, and target speaker extraction. Supporting 10+ audio formats with stereo processing, it offers flexible NumPy interfaces and comprehensive training/inference scripts. Its FRCRN denoiser has surpassed 3 million uses on ModelScope, delivering a production-ready solution for researchers and developers.

repos.description: 🏆 Top-1 on 5+ benchmarks | Web UI | Supports MiroThinker, Claude, Kimi, OpenAI
repos.summary_zh: MiroFlow 是一款性能优先的开源 AI 智能体框架，在 9+ 基准测试中提升任意大模型性能。支持 GPT-5、Claude、Kimi 等模型一键切换，通过智能回滚、迭代推理和工具编排优化表现。提供 FastAPI+React Web 界面、无代码技能系统和多智能体图工作流，适用于模型评估、智能体研发与生产部署，结果完全可复现。
repos.summary_en: MiroFlow is a performance-first open-source AI agent framework that enhances any LLM's capabilities across 9+ benchmarks. It enables one-line model switching between GPT-5, Claude, Kimi, and others via YAML config, optimizing performance through smart rollback, iterative reasoning, and tool orchestration. Features include a FastAPI+React Web UI, code-free skill system, and multi-agent graph workflows, ideal for model evaluation, agent development, and production deployment with fully reproducible results.

repos.description: DeepTeam is a framework to red team LLMs and AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: DeepTeam是开源的LLM红队测试框架，专为AI系统提供安全渗透测试。它通过模拟越狱、提示注入等50+攻击方式，检测AI代理、RAG和聊天机器人中的隐私泄露、偏见等漏洞。基于DeepEval构建，支持本地运行LLM-as-a-Judge评估，并提供生产环境防护护栏，助力AI系统安全加固。
repos.summary_en: DeepTeam is an open-source red teaming framework designed for LLM systems, functioning as penetration testing for AI. It simulates over 50 attacks like jailbreaking and prompt injection to uncover vulnerabilities such as data leakage and bias in AI agents, RAG pipelines, and chatbots. Built on DeepEval, it runs locally with LLM-as-a-Judge metrics and offers guardrails for production security, strengthening AI system resilience.

repos.description: Find, benchmark and install in CLI 170+ FREE coding LLM models across 15+ providers in real time
repos.summary_zh: 该工具解决了开发者在170+免费AI编程模型中选择的难题。它能实时并行测试15+提供商的模型，通过智能算法计算稳定性分数（综合p95延迟、抖动、峰值率和正常运行时间），并将最优模型一键集成到各种AI编程工具中，让开发者从选择到编码只需不到10秒。
repos.summary_en: This powerful CLI tool solves developers' biggest pain point when using free AI coding models: uncertainty about which model is fastest and most stable at any given moment. It continuously benchmarks approximately 170 free or free-limited coding LLMs across 15 trusted providers in real-time, calculating a comprehensive Stability Score that evaluates p95 latency (30%), jitter/variance (30%), spike rate (20%), and uptime (20%). Once you select a model, it instantly configures your preferred AI coding environment—whether it's Continue, Cline, OpenHands, Aider, or dozens of others—getting you from question to coding in under 10 seconds.

repos.description: A curated list of medical LLMs, multimodal systems, datasets, benchmarks, and more. 🏥
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是医疗人工智能领域的系统化资源大全，全面涵盖医学大语言模型、多模态医疗系统、专业数据集与权威评测基准。通过自动化提取海量论文与开源项目中的前沿模型和数据集，提供清晰、结构化且易于导航的集合，帮助研究人员和开发者快速追踪领域进展、精准定位所需资源，显著加速医学AI领域的创新与应用落地。
repos.summary_en: A curated repository systematically organizing medical AI research resources, including medical large language models, multimodal systems, specialized datasets, and evaluation benchmarks. Through automated extraction of trending models and datasets from extensive research papers and open-source projects, it provides a clean, structured, and easily navigable collection. This comprehensive resource helps researchers and developers quickly track field advancements, precisely locate relevant resources, and accelerate innovation in medical artificial intelligence applications, significantly reducing the time needed to discover and utilize state-of-the-art medical AI technologies.

repos.description: Find your agents errors be fore your real users do
repos.summary_zh: ArkSim 是一款 AI 智能体仿真测试平台，通过 LLM 驱动的虚拟用户模拟真实多轮对话，在上线前自动检测智能体错误。提供 7 大内置评估指标，支持自定义度量，自动分类错误并分级。协议无关，支持 Chat Completions API 和 A2A 协议，生成可视化 HTML 报告，帮助开发者提前发现并修复问题。
repos.summary_en: ArkSim is an AI agent simulation testing platform that uses LLM-powered virtual users to simulate realistic multi-turn conversations, automatically detecting agent errors before deployment. It offers 7 built-in evaluation metrics, supports custom metrics, automatically categorizes and prioritizes failures. Protocol-agnostic, works with Chat Completions API and A2A, generating interactive HTML reports to help developers identify and fix issues proactively.

repos.description: TypeScript SDK for the NitroPing audit log — batching client, error capture, Hono/Express/Nitro adapters, and GenAI cost tracing.
repos.summary_zh: nitroping-sdk 是 nitroping.dev 平台的官方多语言客户端库，支持 TypeScript、Swift、Python、Go、Kotlin、PHP 等语言，封装 REST API 实现设备令牌注册（APNs/FCM/Web Push）、多渠道通知发送（推送、邮件、SMS、Slack）、定向/定时/循环推送、Web Push 订阅与 UI 组件、内置收件箱及 Webhook 验证。适用于移动/Web 应用与服务器端通知集成，提供统一 API、公私钥认证和幂等性支持，实现跨平台一致体验。
repos.summary_en: nitroping-sdk offers official client libraries for the nitroping.dev platform across TypeScript, Swift, Python, Go, Kotlin, and PHP. It wraps the REST API for device token registration (APNs/FCM/Web Push), multi-channel notifications (push, email, SMS, Slack), targeted/scheduled/recurring sends, Web Push subscriptions with UI widgets, in-app inbox, and webhook verification. Ideal for mobile/web apps and servers needing unified, secure cross-platform notification delivery with public/secret key auth and idempotency.
